definition: Operating income allocated to the reported customer-industry segments, before the reconciliation to overall company profit. It is not net profit.
notes: Segments group customer industries, not individual Infosys products such as Topaz or Cobalt. Segment names are shortened: Financial Services includes insurance; Retail includes consumer packaged goods and logistics; Communication includes telecom equipment makers and media; Life Sciences includes health care. Segment operating income is not profit after tax. Unallocated expenses of 6,191 sit outside the segments and include 1,289 for the Labour Codes (new wage and labour rules).
insight: Financial Services is the largest contributor to both revenue and segment operating income. Retail earns more segment operating income than Manufacturing despite lower sales.
